authority: Existing user-authorized bounded J-Link capability investigation
source_review: Only creates a Vulkan instance, enumerates physical-device extensions/properties/UUIDs, queries exact external buffer properties for two handle types and two usages, then destroys the instance. No VkDevice, buffer/memory/import, command submission, semaphore or kernel.
guards: Verify exact source, executable and controller pins before and after.
Own a retained hidden process; no shell; monotonic deadline and concurrent bounded stream readers.
On timeout/overflow/error, kill only the retained owned process, reap and stop without retry.
Validate complete JSON on exit zero; raw output and process state remain independent of capability adjudication.
Do not modify parent environment or driver/device/global Factory settings.
qualification_limits: Capability bits do not prove successful import, payload transfer, physical residency or direct VRAM P2P.
Intel absence means absence in this enumerated Vulkan instance, not an exhaustive OS/hardware proof.
No Intel/NVIDIA link claim is authorized by extension or feature advertisements.
